scope: Populated canonical local D1 suffix failure and lost-observer-acknowledgement acceptance; no remote transport interruption or generic recovery service
failureInjection: Unique ledger-name violation after the exact migration statements and normal new ledger insert in the same local D1 batch
rollbackChecks: Every previous application table row including prior grants and ledger entries
Earlier committed prefixes retained independently in each database
acknowledgementInjection: Explicit observer exception after a successful awaited commit; not a socket or process-crash test
reconciliation: Read the committed ledger/schema before continuing; no replay of committed files, ledger deletion, table drop or backup restore
